zh: 女王大学（Queen's University，简称QU）于1841年10月16日根据英国维多利亚女王颁布的皇家宪章成立，坐落于加拿大安大略省金斯顿市，是安大略省第二古老的大学，也是加拿大历史最久、最有名的大学之一，加拿大U15研究型大学联盟的核心成员。在2026年QS世界大学排名中位列全球第191位。学校以卓越的学术声誉、严谨的研究氛围和多元化的学科设置，成为全球学子攻读研究生的热门选择。
en: Queen's University (QU), established on October 16, 1841, by a royal charter issued by Queen Victoria of the United Kingdom, is located in Kingston, Ontario, Canada. It is the second oldest university in Ontario, one of the oldest and most prestigious universities in Canada, and a core member of the U15 Group of Canadian Research Universities. Ranked 191st in the QS World University Rankings 2026, the university is a popular choice for graduate students worldwide due to its excellent academic reputation, rigorous research environment, and diverse academic programs.
